roadmap.title: First playthrough and chapter activities
roadmap.description: Clear Chapters 1-18 and pick up the intro, combat, chapter, and side-quest achievements along the way, including the Chapter 9 outfit, Chapter 14 letter, and the Johnny incidents.

roadmap.title: Chapter Select collection cleanup
roadmap.description: Use Chapter Select after the first clear to finish the remaining quests, all 31 music discs, the six remaining outfits, the Whack-a-Box and pull-up Pro challenges, and the Divine Gratitude letter.

roadmap.title: Postgame combat mastery
roadmap.description: Reach level 50, finish all 20 battle intel reports, master every weapon and enemy skill, hit 300% stagger, and clear the hard Shinra VR bosses for That's the Smell and Ultimate Weapon.

roadmap.title: Hard difficulty playthrough
roadmap.description: Clear every main-story chapter on Hard difficulty using Chapter Select, carrying over gear, levels, and materia.

roadmap.title: INTERmission first playthrough
roadmap.description: Play both INTERmission chapters with Yuffie, collect all six Happy Turtle flyers, defeat every Fort Condor opponent, and earn the Shinra Box Buster materia.

roadmap.title: INTERmission Hard and Weiss
roadmap.description: Replay the DLC on Hard for The Road to Revenge and Condor Queen, then defeat Pride and Joy Mk 0.5 and Weiss in the combat simulators.

roadmap.title: Master of Fate
roadmap.description: Claim the completion achievement once the Hard clears and every collection are finished.

achievements.description: Earn all FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE achievements.
achievements.sortReason: Final capstone; resolves once the base-game Hard clear, all collections, and the INTERmission Hard clear are done.
achievements.summary: Earn every other FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE achievement.

guide.context: The list covers the base game plus the INTERmission DLC, so the base Hard clear, the collection-heavy achievements, and the INTERmission Hard clear all feed into it.

steps.text: Finish the remaining base-game and INTERmission achievements; the award appears with the last one.
Fight through Mako Reactor 1, defeat the Scorpion Sentinel, and escape the reactor section before the countdown ends; the achievement unlocks at the chapter transition.
Escape the train tunnels and city streets, defeat the Huntsman, then watch Cloud leap onto the train.
Meet Avalanche in the Sector 7 Slums, finish the chapter's activities, defeat the Wall Market Hoodlums, and speak with Jessie outside the apartment.
Clear the opening motorcycle sequence, defeat the Spectres, and board the train at the station.
Follow the train tracks with Stamp to Mako Reactor 5, defeat the Crab Warden, and step onto the reactor platform.
Shut down all three Sun Lamps, finish the plate puzzle, and meet Biggs at the reactor entrance.
Survive the reactor trap and defeat the Airbuster boss.
Explore the Sector 5 Slums with Aerith, deal with Reno and Rude, and slip away from Aerith's house toward Sector 6.
Work through Wall Market, defeat the Hell House in the Corneo Colosseum, and get flushed from the mansion into the sewer.
Defeat Abzu, solve the sewer lever puzzles, and climb out of the sewers.
Cross the Train Graveyard, defeat Ghoul and Eligor, and leave the area.
Defeat Reno and Rude again, then escape the collapsing Sector 5 Pillar.
Enter the underground lab, defeat the Failed Experiment, and reach Wedge.
Return to Wall Market, defeat Abzu in the sewers a second time, and climb the Avalanche-graffiti wall in the Urban Development Area.
Grapple up the collapsed buildings toward Shinra HQ and defeat the Valkyrie.
Navigate Shinra HQ to Hojo's lab, defeat Specimen H0512, and free Aerith.
Pass through Hojo's underlab, defeat Rufus as Cloud and the Arsenal with the rest of the party, and reach the rooftop.
Fight through the Whispers and defeat Sephiroth in the final battle.
Defeat any enemy group; the Shinra soldiers right after the opening train ride are the earliest fight.

achievements.summary: Hit an enemy with an element it is weak to.

guide.context: Assess materia reveals weaknesses. Humans usually fall to fire, machines to lightning, flyers to wind, and monsters to ice.

steps.text: Equip the Assess materia, scan an enemy, then attack it with the element shown as its weakness.

achievements.summary: Free an ally from an enemy's bind.

steps.text: When an ally shows the red Bound alert, attack the enemy holding them until the ally is released.
Fill an enemy's stagger gauge to the top; Assess shows the fastest way to build it.

achievements.sortReason: Three discs are easy to pick up early.

steps.text: Pick up any three music discs. Discs sit in jukeboxes, music vending machines, and with some NPCs, and the map marks a nearby uncollected disc with a music icon and "????".
Finish any green "!" side quest, such as Chadley's Report in Chapter 3.

achievements.sortReason: Used the moment a weapon ability is practiced.

steps.text: Equip a weapon and use its unique weapon ability repeatedly until the proficiency bar reaches 100%.

achievements.description: Level up an orb of materia.
achievements.sortReason: Occurs during the first scrappy fights.
achievements.summary: Level up a piece of materia.

steps.text: Equip a non-maxed materia and earn AP in battle until it gains a level.

achievements.sortReason: First boss fight charges the summon gauge.

steps.text: Equip a summon materia and, during a fight long enough to charge the summon gauge, open the command menu and invoke the summon. The Ifrit materia arrives at the end of Chapter 3.

achievements.description: Get praised by Jessie at the end of the motorcycle mini-game.
achievements.summary: Earn Jessie's praise at the end of the @loc{Chapter 4} motorcycle mini-game.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 4 opening motorcycle chase with most of the bike's health intact; roughly 75% or more earns Jessie's praise.

achievements.description: Rise to the top of the Seventh Heaven darts leaderboard.
achievements.summary: Take first place on the @loc{Seventh Heaven} darts leaderboard.

steps.text: In Chapter 3, play darts at Seventh Heaven while waiting for the meeting and beat Wedge's 8-dart score by finishing within 7 darts. Aim at triple 20 and throw when the outer ring shrinks.

achievements.summary: Obtain the @item{Chocobo & Moogle} summon materia before entering Mako Reactor 5.

steps.text: In Chapter 6, after switching off the three Sun Lamps and before taking the platform, head west of the objective into the optional area. Clear the enemies inside the one-minute timer to reach the generator, then take the red materia behind that door.

achievements.description: Bypass the delta-level security lock in Mako Reactor 5.
achievements.summary: Open the delta-level security door in @loc{Mako Reactor 5}.

steps.text: In Chapter 7, take the second door toward the disposal room and solve the Alpha, Beta, Gamma, and Delta lever puzzles with both sticks, following the audio cue or the orange glow.

achievements.description: Complete all Normal difficulty Whack-a-Box challenges.
achievements.summary: Clear every Normal difficulty Whack-a-Box challenge.

steps.text: After the Chapter 8 quest "A Verified Hero", replay the Whack-a-Box minigame and beat the Pro challenge, prioritizing the +10-second boxes. Braver smashes the 1,500-point boxes.

achievements.description: Decorate the Leaf House with a floral arrangement.

steps.text: During Chapter 8, gather flowers with Aerith and deliver them to the Leaf House; the achievement unlocks when the finished arrangement is shown to you later.

achievements.sortReason: Chadley VR summon, first available in Chapter 8.

steps.text: Challenge a summon in Chadley's VR simulator and defeat it. Shiva is the first and unlocks after four battle intel reports; four summon fights exist.

achievements.summary: Clear every squat challenge, including the Pro event.

steps.text: After the Chapter 9 quest "Burning Thighs", play the squat minigame and beat the Pro challenge by following the Y, B, A, X prompts at Cloud's accelerating pace.

achievements.description: Earn a gift from Andrea for dancing like a superstar.
achievements.summary: Earn Andrea's gift for a superstar performance at the @loc{Honeybee Inn}.

guide.context: Andrea judges the dance sequence, and the threshold is forgiving.

steps.text: In the Chapter 9 Honeybee Inn dance, press the prompted button as the hexagon reaches its lowest point; about 23 Great and 5 Good hits is enough for Andrea's gift.

achievements.description: Emerge victorious from a colosseum sparring session.

steps.text: Right after the Chapter 9 Hell House fight, return to the Colosseum basement and win the easiest sparring session. This can also be done in Chapter 14 or later through Chapter Select.

achievements.sortReason: Recorded during the first trip through Chapter 9.

steps.text: Play Chapters 3, 8, and 9 and make the outfit choices; seeing each character in Chapter 9 records one outfit apiece.

achievements.description: Obtain all nine bridal candidate outfits.
achievements.sortReason: Chapter Select cleanup for the remaining six outfits.
achievements.summary: Obtain all nine bridal candidate outfits.

guide.context: An outfit is only logged when the character appears wearing it in Chapter 9, and Chapter Select lets you jump from Chapter 3 straight to Chapter 8 without replaying Chapters 4-7.

steps.text: Tifa's Chapter 3 outfit is set after the "Alone at Last" discovery quest: choosing Mature, or skipping the Chapter 3 quests, gives the Blue Dress; Sporty gives the Chinese Dress; and Exotic gives the Kimono.
Aerith's Chapter 8 dress depends on how many of the six Chapter 8 quests you finish: 0-2 gives the Simple Pink Dress, 3-5 gives the Pink Dress, and all six gives the Red Dress.

Cloud's Chapter 9 suit depends on the quest set you complete: no quests gives the black suit with white ribbons, Set 2 (Burning Thighs plus The Price of Thievery plus Shears' Counterattack) gives the white/black suit with tiara, and Set 1 (Burning Thighs plus The Party Never Stops plus A Dynamite Body) gives the blue/black suit with black ribbon.
Play Chapters 3, 8, and 9 three times with different combinations; a character's outfit registers the first time they appear in Chapter 9.
Check the pause menu under System > Play Log to confirm each logged outfit before moving on.

achievements.description: Complete all Hard difficulty Whack-a-Box challenges.
achievements.summary: Clear every Hard difficulty Whack-a-Box challenge.

guide.context: The Pro challenge only opens if the Chapter 8 quest "A Verified Hero" unlocked the minigame, and the game difficulty setting does not restrict it.

steps.text: In Chapter 14, return to the Children's Hideout, play the Pro Whack-a-Box challenge, and reach the target score. Collect every +10-second box, including two tucked behind the starting point.

achievements.summary: Clear every pull-up challenge, including the Pro event.

steps.text: After the Chapter 14 quest "Wavering Heart", play the pull-up minigame and beat the Pro challenge; read the changing Y, A, B, X rhythm and speed up as Tifa does.

achievements.description: Receive a letter from an angel.
achievements.sortReason: Collect the letter before leaving Chapter 14.
achievements.summary: Receive the angel's letter at the end of @loc{Chapter 14}.

guide.context: The letter sits at the Chapter 14 point of no return, once the objective "Over the Wall" is active.

steps.text: In Chapter 14, complete all available side quests (24 in one pass), then pick up the letter on the ground in the Urban Development Area before starting "Over the Wall"; it also grants an Elemental materia.

achievements.sortReason: Four Johnny incidents spread across the story.

guide.context: The two Chapter 9 incidents depend on your choice set, so one of them may need a later Chapter Select pass.

steps.text: Chapter 3: see Johnny's story encounter outside Seventh Heaven.
Chapter 9: clear the Johnny discovery event on the way to Corneo's mansion and answer "Yeah" at the prompt.
Chapter 9: finish the side quest "The Party Never Stops" (Set 1 choices).
Chapter 14: finish the side quest "Tomboy Bandit", complete the following Kyrie task, and return Johnny's wallet near the train station.

achievements.sortReason: Chapter Select finishes the two mutually exclusive Chapter 9 quests.

guide.context: Chapter Select carries quest completion over, so clearing the leftover Chapter 9 set finishes the total.

steps.text: Complete the 24 side quests available in one pass: six in Chapter 3, six in Chapter 8, three in Chapter 9 (Burning Thighs plus one of the two quest sets), and nine in Chapter 14.

Use Chapter Select to replay Chapter 9 and complete the other quest set (either The Party Never Stops plus A Dynamite Body, or The Price of Thievery plus Shears' Counterattack), which makes the full 26.

achievements.sortReason: Chapter Select mops up any discs missed during the story.

guide.context: Chapter Select shows how many discs are still missing per chapter, so any disc missed during the story can be retrieved later.

achievements.sortReason: Chapter Select double XP makes level 50 quick.

guide.context: Level 50 is the cap in this release, so it usually arrives during the Hard run.

steps.text: Keep fighting in the postgame chapter replays or the Chapter 16 combat simulator until one character reaches level 50; Chapter Select double XP and the simulator's EXP Up materia speed it up.

achievements.description: Deal 300% damage to a staggered enemy.
achievements.sortReason: Needs Tifa's True Strike ability first.
achievements.summary: Raise the stagger damage bonus to 300% against one enemy.

guide.context: Only the multiplier built within a single stagger counts, so the target needs enough health to survive the full sequence; killing it too fast on Easy is a common failure.

steps.text: Get Tifa's Purple Pain weapon in Chapter 16 so True Strike is available, then start Chadley's Fat Chocobo VR battle on Normal or Hard.
Before the Chocobo staggers, use Unbridled Strength twice and then Rise and Fall, and hold two ATB bars on Aerith for Ray of Judgement.
Once it staggers, use Rise and Fall, have Aerith cast Ray of Judgement, then land True Strike three times while rebuilding ATB with Tifa's normal attacks.

achievements.sortReason: One-time intel cleanup that also unlocks the Enemy Skill materia.

guide.context: VR difficulty follows the selected game difficulty, and four summon simulations (Shiva, Fat Chocobo, Leviathan, Bahamut) are part of the list.

steps.text: Clear the scanning and combat reports: assess 2, 10, 20, and 30 enemy types, exploit elemental weaknesses, stagger 15 and 40 enemy types, chain unique abilities on staggered enemies ten times, defeat two enemies with one attack, and kill 3 and 10 enemy varieties.
Clear the progression reports: raise the stagger bonus to 200%, use Aerith's Refocus limit break twice, raise 16 weapon abilities to full proficiency, and master all 12 magic materia.
Win the four VR summon battles: Shiva, Fat Chocobo (after reports 1-9), Leviathan (after reports 1-14), and Bahamut (after reports 1-19).
Visit Chadley in Chapters 3, 8, 9, 14, 16, and 17 to turn the finished reports in until all 20 are complete.

achievements.description: Learn all weapon abilities for Cloud, Barret, Tifa, and Aerith.
achievements.sortReason: Master every weapon found across the story.
achievements.summary: Learn all 24 weapon abilities for @npc{Cloud}, @npc{Barret}, @npc{Tifa}, and @npc{Aerith}.

guide.context: A weapon teaches its unique ability permanently once its proficiency bar reaches 100%, and abilities can be raised across multiple battles.

steps.text: Cloud's six weapons: Buster Sword (default), Iron Blade (Chapter 3 story), Nail Bat ("Kids on Patrol", Chapter 8), Hardedge (Chapter 9 Wall Market weapon vendor), Mythril Saber (Chapter 14 Wall Market weapon vendor), and Twin Stinger (Chapter 17 purple chest after crossing the pods with Red XIII).

Tifa's six weapons: Leather Gloves (default), Metal Knuckles (Chapter 5 story), Sonic Strikers (Chapter 7 purple chest in the B5 connecting passageway), Feathered Gloves (Chapter 10 purple chest in drained Aqueduct 1), Mythril Claws (Chapter 13 story), and Purple Pain (Chapter 16 Shinra Tower lobby; take the bars to the right instead of the ladder).

Barret's six weapons: Gatling Gun (default), Light Machine Gun (Chapter 6 story), Big Bertha (Chapter 13/14 Evergreen Park weapon vendor), Steel Pincers (Chapter 14 Moogle Emporium), Wrecking Ball ("Subterranean Menace", Chapter 14), and EKG Cannon (Chapter 16; pay Hart 10,000 gil after speaking to the Mayor).

Aerith's six weapons: Guard Stick (default), Silver Staff (Chapter 8 Moogle Emporium), Arcane Scepter ("A Dynamite Body" or "Shears' Counterattack", Chapter 9), Mythril Rod (Chapter 11 purple chest opposite the starting bench), Bladed Staff (steal from the Chapter 11 boss Eligor using Steal materia, sold by Chadley after intel report 7), and Reinforced Staff (Chapter 17 purple chest at the very start).
Use each weapon's unique ability in battle until its proficiency bar reaches 100%.

achievements.sortReason: Requires the Enemy Skill materia from intel report 16.
achievements.summary: Learn all four enemy skills with the @item{Enemy Skill} materia.

guide.context: The character carrying the materia must be the one hit by the skill, and learned skills can be reviewed in battle under Abilities.

steps.text: Complete battle intel report 16 to receive the Enemy Skill materia, then keep it equipped on the character you want to learn with.

Get hit by each skill: Spirit Siphon from Phantom's Essence Drain (Chapter 14 "Missing Children", or Chapter 16/17 "versus SOLDIER Trainees"); Self-Destruct from Smogger or Trypapolis (Chapter 8/14 scrapyard or Chapter 16/17 "Team Ragbag") or from Bomb (Chapter 9/14 Colosseum "Team Payback", or hard Chapter 17); Algid Aura from Cerulean Drake's Icy Aura (the "Just Flew in from the Graveyard" quest, the Chapter 11 Train Graveyard, or the Colosseum "Team Payback"); and Bad Breath from Malboro in the hard Chapter 17 "Three-Person Team vs. Monsters of Legend".

achievements.summary: Defeat a @enemy{Malboro} in the postgame Shinra combat simulator.

guide.context: The simulation always runs at Hard rules even when the chapter is loaded on a lower difficulty, so items cannot be used.

steps.text: Load Chapter 17 after the story, reach Hojo's lab, and clear "Three-Person Team vs. Monsters of Legend". The rounds are Boom, Tonberry, Behemoth, Boom plus Tonberry, then Malboro. Bring Revival and Healing materia on everyone and Magnify with Healing on Cloud; Bad Breath is the only move that threatens a wipe.

achievements.description: Defeat the Pride and Joy Prototype.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Pride and Joy Prototype} in the postgame Shinra combat simulator.

guide.context: Only this final simulator fight is Hard-locked; the prerequisite Colosseum and simulator challenges can be cleared on a lower difficulty.

steps.text: Load Chapter 17 on Hard, reach the Hojo lab simulator, and clear every challenge up to the final fight against the Pride and Joy Prototype. Prerequisites are all Corneo Colosseum fights from Chapters 9 and 14 (including Aerith's solo fight, taken immediately after the Chapter 9 Hell House) and the 13 Chapter 17 simulator challenges. The reward is the Götterdämmerung accessory.

achievements.description: Complete all chapters of the main story on Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete all 18 main-story chapters on Hard difficulty.

guide.context: Hard removes item use, stops benches from restoring MP, and strengthens enemies, but Chapter Select carries over equipment, levels, and materia and grants double XP and triple AP.

steps.text: Open the pause menu, choose System > Chapter Selection, set the difficulty to Hard, and clear all 18 chapters. Finish a chapter for it to count, and clear them in any order.

guide.context: INTERmission is the Yuffie DLC bundled in INTERGRADE and can be launched from the main menu.

steps.text: Play through the first INTERmission chapter on any difficulty.
Play through the second INTERmission chapter on any difficulty.

achievements.description: Complete both chapters of INTERmission on Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete both INTERmission chapters on Hard difficulty.

guide.context: INTERmission Hard unlocks after one DLC clear.

steps.text: Replay both INTERmission chapters on Hard. Put Prayer and Magnify with Healing on the party and a maxed Revival on Yuffie, and use Shinra Boxes, which respawn after a save and reload, for MP. Assess every opponent and exploit weaknesses with Yuffie's Ninjutsu and Sonon's Synergized attacks.

achievements.description: Collect all the Happy Turtle flyers.
achievements.sortReason: Collect the six flyers during INTERmission Chapter 1.

guide.context: Talking to Old Snapper during INTERmission Chapter 1 starts the collection, and a jingle plays near each flyer. Handing all six to Old Snapper awards the Magnify materia.

collectibles.name: Happy Turtle Flyer 1
collectibles.location: Sector 7 Slums play area behind Old Snapper
collectibles.method: Check the corner behind the stacked boxes where the kids play.

collectibles.name: Happy Turtle Flyer 2
collectibles.method: Slip behind the house and burst the turtle balloon.

collectibles.name: Happy Turtle Flyer 3
collectibles.method: Go upstairs and hide behind the boxes so Marle's dog does not notice you.

collectibles.name: Happy Turtle Flyer 4
collectibles.method: Chase the cat and check behind the blue barrels.

collectibles.name: Happy Turtle Flyer 5
collectibles.location: Billboard between town and the train station
collectibles.method: Tear the Shinra poster off the bulletin board just past Roche.

collectibles.name: Happy Turtle Flyer 6
collectibles.method: Fight to the Venomantis at the dead end and search the wall behind the boxes.

achievements.sortReason: Fort Condor matches in INTERmission Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Fort Condor grandmaster in INTERmission.

guide.context: The story forces a tutorial match, after which every opponent is marked on the map.

steps.text: Play the tutorial Fort Condor match, then beat every opponent marked on the map and defeat the grandmaster.

achievements.description: Become the Fort Condor grandmaster on Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Defeat every Fort Condor opponent on Hard difficulty in INTERmission.

guide.context: Hard Fort Condor unlocks with INTERmission Hard and repeats every match at the higher difficulty.

steps.text: Replay INTERmission Chapter 1 on Hard and win every Fort Condor match again. A simple plan is to take an ATB-speed board, wait for the opponent's unit, and answer with its direct counter.

achievements.description: Obtain all materia available from Shinra Box Buster challenges.
achievements.sortReason: Shinra Box Buster in INTERmission Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Earn every materia from the Shinra Box Buster challenges in INTERmission.

guide.context: The minigame appears on the map once the story reaches B14 in INTERmission Chapter 2, and neither difficulty nor Yuffie's level changes the outcome.

steps.text: Reach B14 and clear both Shinra Box Buster courses: score at least 20,000 of 30,000 points in Basic Training and the full 50,000 points in SOLDIER Training.

achievements.description: Defeat the Pride and Joy Mk 0.5.
achievements.sortReason: Hard simulator superboss in INTERmission Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Pride and Joy Mk 0.5} in the INTERmission Hard combat simulator.

steps.text: In INTERmission Chapter 2 on Hard, clear the first two encounters of the Shinra combat simulator at the chapter start, then defeat Pride and Joy Mk 0.5 in the third.

achievements.sortReason: Weiss fight in main-game Hard Chapter 17.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Weiss} in the main-game Hard combat simulator.

guide.context: The Weiss fight unlocks at the same time as INTERmission Hard mode.

steps.text: Load the main game's Chapter 17 on Hard, reach the Shinra combat simulator in Hojo's lab, and defeat Weiss.
